examples.zh: 你最喜欢哪个学科？
examples.en: Which subject do you like best?

examples.zh: 这所大学的医学学科很有名。
examples.en: This university's medical programs are well known.

examples.zh: 现在很多学科都需要学一点数据分析。
examples.en: Many fields now require learning a bit of data analysis.

note: Pattern: 正如 + (someone) 所说/所见, ... ; formal.

examples.zh: 正如你所说，这个办法确实有用。
examples.en: Just as you said, this method really works.

examples.zh: 正如大家看到的，我们的工作很顺利。
examples.en: As you can all see, our work is going smoothly.

examples.zh: 正如天气预报说的，今天下大雨了。
examples.en: Just as the weather forecast said, it's raining hard today.

meaning: to visit or send greetings to comfort someone

senses.en: to visit or send greetings to comfort someone

note: Formal; the object is people in hardship, illness or on duty.

examples.zh: 领导去医院慰问受伤的工人。
examples.en: The leaders went to the hospital to visit the injured workers.

examples.zh: 听说你生病了，我来慰问你。
examples.en: I heard you were ill, so I came to see how you are.

examples.zh: 春节前，我们去慰问没有家人的老人。
examples.en: Before the Spring Festival, we went to visit old people with no family.

examples.zh: 他每天看新闻，很关心时事。
examples.en: He watches the news every day and follows current affairs closely.

examples.zh: 我们常常说时事和国际新闻。
examples.en: We often talk about current affairs and world news.

examples.zh: 你对时事感兴趣吗？
examples.en: Are you interested in current affairs?

meaning: the legal system; the rule of law

senses.en: the legal system; the rule of law

note: Formal; often 法制 建设/教育. Not the same as 法治.

examples.zh: 国家要加强法制建设。
examples.en: The country must strengthen its legal system.

examples.zh: 学校给学生上法制教育课。
examples.en: The school gives students classes on the legal system.

examples.zh: 法制越完善，生活越安全。
examples.en: The better the legal system, the safer life is.

meaning: property management; the management company of a residential complex

senses.en: property management; the management company of a residential complex

note: In China, 物业 is who you call for repairs, fees and security in your compound.

examples.zh: 家里没水了，我给物业打了电话。
examples.en: The water was off at home, so I called property management.

examples.zh: 我们家的物业费每月交一次。
examples.en: The property management fee is paid once a month.

examples.zh: 请问，物业办公室在哪里？
examples.en: Excuse me, where is the property management office?

examples.zh: 我想给国外的朋友汇款。
examples.en: I want to send money to a friend abroad.

examples.zh: 你的汇款今天能到吗？
examples.en: Will your remittance arrive today?

examples.zh: 银行说，汇款要收钱。
examples.en: The bank says it charges a fee for transfers.

examples.zh: 这条路又宽又平坦，开车很舒服。
examples.en: This road is wide and smooth, so driving is comfortable.

examples.zh: 山区里很难找到平坦的地方。
examples.en: It's hard to find flat ground in the mountains.

examples.zh: 孩子在平坦的操场上跑。
examples.en: The child runs on the flat playground.

meaning: to establish firmly (a goal, system, relationship)

senses.en: to establish firmly (a goal, system, relationship)

note: Formal; objects are abstract: 目标, 地位, 制度.

examples.zh: 公司确立了新的发展目标。
examples.en: The company set a new development goal.

examples.zh: 两国确立了合作关系。
examples.en: The two countries established a cooperative relationship.

examples.zh: 他很早就确立了自己的人生目标。
examples.en: He set his life goals very early.

note: Followed by a verb: 便于携带 (easy to carry).

examples.zh: 这个包有很多口袋，便于放小东西。
examples.en: This bag has many pockets, which makes it easy to keep small things.

examples.zh: 我把文件放在一起，便于以后找。
examples.en: I put the files together so they're easy to find later.

examples.zh: 他住在地铁站旁边，便于上班。
examples.en: He lives next to the subway station, which is convenient for commuting.

examples.zh: 她喜欢读散文，不太爱看小说。
examples.en: She likes reading essays and doesn't care much for novels.

examples.zh: 这篇散文写得很美。
examples.en: This essay is beautifully written.

examples.zh: 我想写一篇关于家乡的散文。
examples.en: I want to write a prose piece about my hometown.

examples.zh: 他一口气跑了五公里。
examples.en: He ran five kilometers without stopping.

examples.zh: 这本书太好看了，我一口气看完了。
examples.en: This book was so good that I read it all in one go.

examples.zh: 你能一口气说完这句话吗？
examples.en: Can you say this sentence in one breath?

examples.zh: 地震是一种自然灾害。
examples.en: An earthquake is a kind of natural disaster.

examples.zh: 这个地区经常发生灾害。
examples.en: Disasters often happen in this region.

examples.zh: 我们应该学习怎样面对灾害。
examples.en: We should learn how to face disasters.

meaning: to assess (work or study performance); an assessment

senses.en: to assess (work or study performance); an assessment

examples.zh: 公司每年考核一次员工。
examples.en: The company assesses its employees once a year.

examples.zh: 年底考核的结果出来了吗？
examples.en: Are the year-end appraisal results out yet?

examples.zh: 老师用考试和作业考核学生。
examples.en: The teacher assesses students with exams and homework.

examples.zh: 长城看起来非常雄伟。
examples.en: The Great Wall looks magnificent.

examples.zh: 远处是一座雄伟的大山。
examples.en: In the distance is a majestic mountain.

examples.zh: 这座建筑多么雄伟啊！
examples.en: How imposing this building is!

meaning: grand prix; a major prize competition

senses.en: grand prix; a major prize competition

examples.zh: 他去北京参加了一个国际大奖赛。
examples.en: He went to Beijing to take part in an international grand prix.

examples.zh: 这次大奖赛的第一名能得到多少钱？
examples.en: How much money does first place in this competition get?

examples.zh: 这场大奖赛吸引了很多观众。
examples.en: This competition drew a large audience.

examples.zh: 他对天文很感兴趣，常常看星星。
examples.en: He is very interested in astronomy and often looks at the stars.

examples.zh: 周末我们去看天文展览吧。
examples.en: Let's go see the astronomy exhibition this weekend.

examples.zh: 我儿子想学天文专业。
examples.en: My son wants to study astronomy.

meaning: to implement or roll out (a policy, system)

senses.en: to implement or roll out (a policy, system)

note: Formal; objects are policies, systems, methods.

examples.zh: 学校从下个月开始推行新规定。
examples.en: The school will start implementing a new rule next month.

examples.zh: 这个新规定已经在全国推行了。
examples.en: This rule has already been rolled out nationwide.

examples.zh: 公司想推行在家工作，你觉得怎么样？
examples.en: The company wants to introduce working from home. What do you think?

examples.zh: 他周末去学书法。
examples.en: He goes to learn calligraphy on weekends.

examples.zh: 他的书法写得真漂亮。
examples.en: His calligraphy is really beautiful.

examples.zh: 练书法可以让人安静下来。
examples.en: Practicing calligraphy can calm you down.

examples.zh: 最近水果又涨价了。
examples.en: Fruit has gone up in price again lately.

examples.zh: 房租涨价了，我想搬家。
examples.en: The rent went up, and I want to move.

examples.zh: 商店通知下个月要涨价。
examples.en: The shop announced that prices will go up next month.
